_about: The Quest Book's story (src/world/quest_book.py; kanto_handoff/QUEST_BOOK_DESIGN.md): per region, arcs of chapters over the Journal's missions. A chapter: mission (its id), title, say (its page), optional steps (part of a mission: those way-points), done / when (the chapter's own conditions).

chapters.title: The First Step
chapters.say: The tall grass north of Pallet Town is calling. Something tells you today won't be an ordinary day...

chapters.title: Three Poke Balls
chapters.say: Three Poke Balls sit on Professor Oak's table. One of them holds the partner who'll go everywhere with you.

chapters.title: An Errand Up North
chapters.say: The road north leads to Viridian City. The shopkeeper there has been waiting for someone from Pallet Town.

chapters.title: The Professor's Gift
chapters.say: The parcel is light, but Professor Oak will want it in his hands. He looked like he had plans for you.

chapters.title: Into the Forest
chapters.say: Past Route 2 the trees close in. Bug Catchers know every path of Viridian Forest... and every trap.

chapters.title: Hard as Rock
chapters.say: Pewter City is a city of stone, and its Gym Leader is the hardest stone of all.

chapters.title: East to the Mountain
chapters.say: Route 3 winds east toward a mountain where, they say, stones fell from the stars.

chapters.title: Shadows in Mt. Moon
chapters.say: Men in black uniforms are digging deep in the cave. Whatever they're after, they don't want to be seen.

chapters.title: Light at the End
chapters.say: The tunnels go on and on. Somewhere ahead, the air smells of water.

chapters.title: The Man in the Cottage
chapters.say: North of Cerulean a bridge full of trainers, and past it a seaside cottage. The scientist who lives there hasn't been himself lately.

chapters.title: The Tomboyish Mermaid
chapters.say: Cerulean's Gym Leader rules the water. Her pool has swallowed many challengers.

chapters.title: South to the Sea
chapters.say: Below Saffron's locked gates runs a tunnel to the coast, and to Kanto's busiest port.

chapters.title: A Ship at the Harbour
chapters.say: A luxury liner is in port, and your ticket says you're invited. Its Captain hasn't left his cabin in days.

chapters.title: The Lightning American
chapters.say: Vermilion's Gym crackles behind a little tree. Its Leader once won a war with Electric Pokemon.

chapters.title: The Dark Tunnel
chapters.say: East of Cerulean lies a tunnel with no light at all. On the other side, a quiet town.

chapters.title: Whispers in Lavender
chapters.say: Lavender Town is quiet, too quiet. People say a ghost walks the Pokemon Tower, and that no one can see what it really is.

chapters.title: The Poster on the Wall
chapters.say: Celadon's Game Corner is loud and bright. But the man by the poster at the back isn't playing...

chapters.title: Under the Game Corner
chapters.say: Arrows on the floor, an elevator with no key, and somewhere below, the boss of Team Rocket.

chapters.title: Nature's Gym
chapters.say: Celadon's Gym is a garden, and its Leader is said to be gentle. Her Pokemon are not.

chapters.title: The Ghost of the Tower
chapters.say: With the Silph Scope, the Tower's ghost can't hide any more. And at the very top, someone needs help.

chapters.title: The Sleeping Giant
chapters.say: Something enormous is asleep across the road south of Lavender. Nothing seems to wake it... nearly nothing.

chapters.title: The Ninja's Gym
chapters.say: Fuchsia's Gym is a maze of walls you can't see. Its Leader is a master of poison.

chapters.title: The House in the Safari
chapters.say: At the far end of the Safari Zone stands a little house. They say whoever reaches it is given a gift for the sea.

chapters.title: The Warden's Smile
chapters.say: The Safari Zone's Warden is mumbling something nobody can understand. Something of his is missing out in the Zone.

chapters.title: Thirsty Guards
chapters.say: Saffron's gates are guarded day and night, and the guards look parched. Someone in Celadon makes a very good cup of tea.

chapters.title: Silph Co. Taken
chapters.say: Team Rocket has seized the tallest building in Kanto. Doors are locked on every floor, but keys have a way of being dropped.

chapters.title: The Boardroom
chapters.say: A warp pad, an old rival, and at the top of the tower the man behind everything.

chapters.title: The President's Thanks
chapters.say: Silph Co. is free. Its President is waiting upstairs, and he's not a man who forgets a favour.

chapters.title: The Master of Psychic
chapters.say: With the Rockets gone, Saffron's real Gym opens its doors. Its Leader is said to read minds.

chapters.title: Across the Water
chapters.say: An island with a volcano lies south of Kanto. Only a Pokemon that can Surf will get you there.

chapters.title: The Burned Mansion
chapters.say: The Gym door won't open. On the north of the island, a burned mansion keeps a diary nobody was meant to read.

chapters.title: The Hotheaded Quiz Master
chapters.say: Cinnabar's Gym is full of questions, and its Leader is full of fire.

chapters.title: A Ferry to One Island
chapters.say: Bill is waiting at Cinnabar's harbour with two ferry tickets. A friend of his on a faraway island needs a hand.

chapters.title: Rumbles on Mt. Ember
chapters.say: Researchers at the foot of Mt. Ember have seen people digging where nobody should dig.

chapters.title: The Diggers
chapters.say: The way into the Ruby Path is blocked by Team Rocket. Two of them you've met before.

chapters.title: Deep in the Ruby Path
chapters.say: Whatever the diggers were after is still down there, past the door they were guarding.

chapters.title: A Gem for Celio
chapters.say: A red stone, warm to the touch. Celio's machine has been waiting for something just like it.

chapters.title: The Missing Girl
chapters.say: A little girl from Two Island went out to pick berries and never came home.

chapters.title: Bikers on Three Island
chapters.say: A gang of bikers has taken over Three Island, and they don't like visitors.

chapters.title: Into the Berry Forest
chapters.say: Past Bond Bridge the Berry Forest grows thick and dark. Somewhere inside, someone is crying.

chapters.title: The Leader Returns
chapters.say: The lights are on in Viridian's Gym at last. Its Leader has come home, and he's been waiting for you.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.say: West of Viridian a road climbs through the rock. Only trainers with all eight badges are allowed to try it.

chapters.title: The Elite Four
chapters.say: Four of the strongest trainers in Kanto stand between you and the title. And behind them, someone you know.

chapters.title: A Bigger Pokedex
chapters.say: You're the Champion now. Professor Oak has been waiting to see just how many Pokemon you've met.

chapters.title: The Rainbow Pass
chapters.say: Celio has a pass that opens the rest of the Sevii Islands. Islands nobody from Kanto has seen in years.

chapters.title: The Lady of Four Island
chapters.say: An old friend has gone home to Four Island. She's heard troubling things about the ice cave across the water.

chapters.title: Icefall Cave
chapters.say: Someone is catching Pokemon deep in the frozen cave, and they aren't catching them kindly.

chapters.title: The Dotted Hole
chapters.say: In Ruin Valley there's a door covered in strange dots. Behind it lies a blue gem... and someone else wants it.

chapters.title: The Rocket Warehouse
chapters.say: Team Rocket's warehouse on Five Isle Meadow is locked tight. Only their own passwords will open it.

chapters.title: The Machine Awakes
chapters.say: Ruby and Sapphire, side by side at last. Celio's machine is ready to reach the whole world.

chapters.title: The Professor's Errand
chapters.say: Prof. Elm has a friend on Route 30 who says he's found something amazing. Elm won't say what it is. Maybe he doesn't know.

chapters.title: Mr. Pokemon's Discovery
chapters.say: A little house at the end of Route 30. The old man inside guards his find like treasure... and today he has a famous visitor.

chapters.title: A Stranger in Cherrygrove
chapters.say: On the road home, a red-haired boy steps out in front of you. He looks like he's been waiting.

chapters.title: Trouble at the Lab
chapters.say: There's a policeman at Prof. Elm's Lab, and the Professor looks pale. Something has gone missing.

chapters.title: The Swaying Tower
chapters.say: Sprout Tower sways but never falls. The Sages at the top test every trainer who climbs it... and someone has already climbed it today.

chapters.title: Wings Over Violet
chapters.say: Violet's Gym stands high above the city. Its Leader says no one has ever clipped his Pokemon's wings.

chapters.title: Something Warm
chapters.say: Word from the Pokemon Center: Prof. Elm's aide came all the way to Violet, and she's carrying something round and warm. She won't let anyone else hold it.

chapters.title: Under the Ground
chapters.say: South of Violet, the road dives into Union Cave. Somewhere past the dark, a sleepy town is waiting.

chapters.title: The Well of Tails
chapters.say: Azalea's Slowpoke have gone missing, and men in black stand guard at the old well. An old ball-maker named Kurt is furious.

chapters.title: The Bug Master
chapters.say: With the well quiet again, Azalea's Gym opens its doors. Its young Leader knows everything about Bug Pokemon... and they swarm.

chapters.title: The Runaway Bird
chapters.say: In Ilex Forest it's dark even at noon. A charcoal maker's apprentice has lost his Farfetch'd somewhere among the trees.

chapters.title: The Big City
chapters.say: North of the forest lies Goldenrod, the biggest city in Johto. You can hear it long before you see it.

chapters.title: Rumours on Route 36
chapters.say: Everyone in Goldenrod is talking about a tree on Route 36 that wiggles. Trees don't wiggle. Do they?

chapters.title: The Unstoppable Miltank
chapters.say: Goldenrod's Gym Leader smiles a lot. Trainers who've faced her Miltank don't.

chapters.title: The Tree That Wiggled
chapters.say: That tree on Route 36 is still in the way. The girl at Goldenrod's flower shop might know what a thirsty tree needs.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Burned Tower
chapters.say: Ecruteak's Burned Tower fell to a fire long ago. Someone you know is already inside, poking through the ashes.

chapters.title: Three Beasts Awaken
chapters.say: Deep in the basement, three shapes lie still under the ash. The old stories say they are waiting for someone.

chapters.title: The Mystic Seer
chapters.say: Ecruteak's Gym Leader sees things no one else can. Watch your step: his Gym hides more than it shows.

chapters.title: The Dancers' Trouble
chapters.say: Olivine's lighthouse has gone dark, and its keeper won't leave her sick Ampharos. Meanwhile, back in Ecruteak, a stranger in black is bothering the Kimono Girls.

chapters.title: The Dark Tower
chapters.say: Olivine's lighthouse stands dark against the sea. Someone is keeping watch at the very top, and she hasn't come down in days.

chapters.title: Across the Whirling Sea
chapters.say: Cianwood City lies across the open sea, west of Olivine. Its pharmacy makes a medicine no one else can.

chapters.title: The Secret Potion
chapters.say: The pharmacist knows exactly what Amphy needs. He's just been waiting for someone to ask.

chapters.title: The Waterfall Fighter
chapters.say: Cianwood's Gym Leader trains under a waterfall, all day, every day. His Pokemon hit like falling rocks.

chapters.title: A Light for the Sea
chapters.say: Amphy is waiting at the top of the lighthouse, and the ships out at sea are waiting for its light.

chapters.title: The Steel-Clad Defense
chapters.say: With the lighthouse shining again, Olivine's Gym Leader is back at her post. Her Steel Pokemon don't dent easily.

chapters.title: The Red Gyarados
chapters.say: Strange news from the Lake of Rage, north of Mahogany Town: a lake that won't calm down, and a Gyarados as red as fire.

chapters.title: The Shop with No Customers
chapters.say: A trainer in a cape has been watching the lake too. He says Mahogany's little souvenir shop is hiding something big.

chapters.title: Ice on the Floor
chapters.say: Mahogany's Gym is a floor of ice. Its Leader is old, patient, and very, very cold.

chapters.title: The Tower Taken
chapters.say: Goldenrod's radio is playing a voice it shouldn't. Team Rocket has taken the Radio Tower, and they're calling out for their missing boss.

chapters.title: Under Goldenrod
chapters.say: The key opens a door deep beneath the city's streets. Someone down there has been locked away for days.

chapters.title: The Top of the Tower
chapters.say: The card opens the upper floors. At the very top, the last of Team Rocket's leaders is waiting.

chapters.title: The Ice Path
chapters.say: East of Mahogany, a frozen cave climbs into the mountains. The floor is ice, and the ice doesn't let you stop.

chapters.title: The Dragon Tamer
chapters.say: Blackthorn's Gym Leader is proud, sharp and cousin to a very famous trainer. Her dragons don't like to lose.

chapters.title: The Elder's Questions
chapters.say: She won't hand the badge over. Instead she points to a shrine in a cave full of dragons, where an old man waits with questions.

chapters.title: Three Wise Sages
chapters.say: Bellchime Trail rings with bells nobody is ringing. Three sages guard the way, and they don't step aside for just anyone.

chapters.title: A Wing of Many Colours
chapters.say: Inside the Bell Tower, an old Sage is holding something for you. It shimmers in every colour at once.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.say: East of New Bark, the road to the League crosses the sea and climbs through the rock. Only trainers with all eight badges get through.

chapters.title: The Elite Four
chapters.say: Four of the strongest trainers in Johto stand between you and the title. Behind them waits a man in a cape.

chapters.title: The Trainer in the Snow
chapters.say: High on Mt. Silver, where the snow never stops, someone has been training alone for years. They say he never says a word.

chapters.title: Oranges and Sea Salt
chapters.say: Valencia Island smells of oranges and sea salt. Somewhere out on its western beach, a professor is waiting for you.

chapters.title: Prof. Ivy's Partner
chapters.say: Prof. Ivy's lab is full of Pokemon that look a little different out here. One Poke Ball on her desk is meant for you.

chapters.title: The Flowers of Valencia Park
chapters.say: Prof. Ivy is watching the wild Vileplume in the park. They look peaceful. They're not always.

chapters.title: A Cloud of Spores
chapters.say: Something went wrong in the park. The professor needs a Pokemon Center, fast.

chapters.title: A Ride in the Sky
chapters.say: The next island is over the sea, and there's no boat. But a blimp flies right over it...

chapters.title: Dropping In
chapters.say: You landed in the middle of Tangelo's Pokemon Park. The town is somewhere to the west, past the trees.

chapters.title: Shouting by the Water
chapters.say: Someone is shouting at the north end of Tangelo Island. It doesn't sound like a happy shout.

chapters.title: The Hurt Lapras
chapters.say: A young Lapras, hurt and all alone. Tangelo's Nurse Joy is doing everything she can.

chapters.title: A Friend in the Pool
chapters.say: Lapras is resting in the pool behind the Pokemon Center. Someone else has their eye on it too.

chapters.title: Good News to Share
chapters.say: Lapras wants to come with you. Misty and Tracey will want to hear about this.

chapters.title: Riding the Waves
chapters.say: With Lapras, the whole sea is open. North across Route 50 lies Mikan Island, and the first Gym of the Orange Crew.

chapters.title: The First of the Crew
chapters.say: The Orange Crew don't battle like other Gyms. Mikan's Leader has tests for you before she'll even pick a Poke Ball.

chapters.title: The Busy City
chapters.say: East along Route 53, Mandarin Island North is all crowds and noise. Something about it feels wrong.

chapters.title: Pokemon Gone Wild
chapters.say: Pokemon all over Mandarin are turning on their trainers. Officer Jenny wants to know why, and so do you.

chapters.title: The Giant Antenna
chapters.say: North of the city stands an old power plant with a huge antenna. It's been humming day and night.

chapters.title: A Climber's Thanks
chapters.say: Mandarin is calm again, and a climber in town wants to give you something. Then south, to an island made of glass.

chapters.title: The Crystal Cave
chapters.say: Sunburst Island is famous for glass. Tracey has heard of a Pokemon in its cave that light shines straight through.

chapters.title: Pink on the Horizon
chapters.say: South, then east, lies Pinkan Island, where they say every Pokemon is pink. Every single one.

chapters.title: The Pink Rhyhorn
chapters.say: Tracey is sketching a Rhyhorn the colour of candy. Pinkan's Pokemon are rare, and some people know it.

chapters.title: Poachers on Pinkan
chapters.say: Poachers have come to Pinkan, and the island's Pokemon are angry. A familiar face is out there too.

chapters.title: A Rival's Tip
chapters.say: {rival_name} says the next Gym is far to the east. The sea is wide, and the islands are getting fewer.

chapters.title: Fukuhara Crossing
chapters.say: Fukuhara Island lies on the way east. Beyond it, the route turns north toward a busy port.

chapters.title: The Port of Kinnow
chapters.say: Ships come and go from Kinnow all day. The next Gym is east of here, on an island that's mostly mountain.

chapters.title: The Mountain Gym
chapters.say: Navel Island has no Gym building. Its Leader is waiting at the very top of the mountain, and the only way up is to climb.

chapters.title: Past the Grapefruit Islands
chapters.say: Two badges. South from Navel, past seven little islands, lies Moro Island and its famous museum.

chapters.title: The Island of Bugs
chapters.say: Murcott Island is home to Bug Pokemon of every kind. Tracey can hardly wait.

chapters.title: The Biggest Island
chapters.say: South past the island of Farfetch'd lies Mandarin Island South, the biggest of the Orange Islands.

chapters.title: {rival_name} Again
chapters.say: Someone else is touring the Orange Islands. And they've been waiting for you on the north road.

chapters.title: The Road to Yambera
chapters.say: Route 63 heads north from Mandarin South. Three familiar shadows are hiding along it.

chapters.title: Quiet Yambera
chapters.say: Yambera is a sleepy little village. Sleepy villages always have a story.

chapters.title: The Mandarin Desert
chapters.say: West of Yambera the ground turns to sand and heat. Something odd is happening out in the desert.

chapters.title: The Big City of Trovitopolis
chapters.say: Out of the desert and into the biggest city in the islands. Statues, shops, and a mayor who loves to make speeches.

chapters.title: West to Trovita
chapters.say: The third Gym is on Trovita Island, west along the beach and across the water.

chapters.title: A Gym in the Clouds
chapters.say: Trovita's Gym Leader has a better place for your battle in mind. Higher. Much higher.

chapters.title: Something Handy
chapters.say: Three badges. An islander said a Gym winner deserves something special for the sea. Better find out what.

chapters.title: Through the Whirlpools
chapters.say: Misty and Tracey went north. Fairchild Island's beach is ringed with whirlpools, and you've finally got a way through.

chapters.title: The Island of Giants
chapters.say: Everything on Fairchild Island is bigger. Much bigger. Team Rocket has noticed.

chapters.title: Route 67
chapters.say: Team Rocket ran off in a hurry. North of Fairchild, the sea road goes on.

chapters.title: North to Ascorbia
chapters.say: East along Route 68, then north. Ascorbia Island is known for its brave firefighters.

chapters.title: Team Wartortle
chapters.say: Ascorbia's firefighting squad has been carried off in a balloon. Their Captain is heading into the forest alone.

chapters.title: West to Kumquat
chapters.say: Ascorbia is safe again. West along Route 69 waits Kumquat Island, and the last Gym of the Orange Crew.

chapters.title: The Hotel Gym
chapters.say: Kumquat's Gym is hidden inside a grand hotel. Its Leader says a battle shows how well a trainer and their Pokemon really know each other.

chapters.title: Four Badges
chapters.say: All four Orange Crew badges. The Orange League waits on Pummelo Island, far to the south-west.

chapters.title: One More Rival
chapters.say: Pummelo Island at last. But someone has been waiting on the path, and they're not here to cheer you on.

chapters.title: The Palace of Victory
chapters.say: At the top of the island stands the Palace of Victory. The Champion of the Orange League is inside.

chapters.title: Drake of Pummelo Stadium
chapters.say: Six Pokemon. No time limit. The Champion has never lost a full battle in his stadium.

chapters.title: The Legend Festival
chapters.say: Shamouti Island is having a festival, and everyone's talking about an old legend. Something about a Chosen One.

chapters.title: The Fire Sphere
chapters.say: Three islands, three treasures, one shrine. The first is waiting in the heat of Fire Island.

chapters.title: The Flying Palace
chapters.say: A ship in the sky, and a collector who wants the rarest Pokemon of all. You're aboard now, whether you like it or not.

chapters.title: The Lightning Sphere
chapters.say: The palace has crashed on Lightning Island, and the three great birds are fighting. Hurry.

chapters.title: The Guardian of the Sea
chapters.say: Something carried you back to Shamouti's shrine. The sea is restless, and something deep beneath it is waking.

chapters.title: The Ice Sphere
chapters.say: One treasure is still missing, and only the Chosen One can bring it. Ice Island's cave is on Shamouti's south shore.

chapters.title: A Cry on Route 101
chapters.say: You've only just moved to Littleroot Town, and already someone is shouting for help in the tall grass.

chapters.title: The Professor's Thanks
chapters.say: Professor Birch owes you one. He doesn't seem like a man who forgets.

chapters.title: The Professor's Kid
chapters.say: Birch's kid, {rival_name}, is out on Route 103 studying Pokemon. And probably itching for a battle.

chapters.title: A Pokedex of Your Own
chapters.say: That battle didn't go unnoticed. Back at the lab, the Professor has something waiting for you.

chapters.title: The Petalburg Gym
chapters.say: Your dad is the Gym Leader of Petalburg City. He'll want to see how you're getting on... and a nervous boy is waiting there too.

chapters.title: Trouble in the Woods
chapters.say: Petalburg Woods is quiet and green. Too quiet. A researcher is shouting, and someone in a strange uniform is the reason.

chapters.title: The Rock-Solid Leader
chapters.say: Rustboro's Gym Leader is top of her class and studies every move. Her Rock Pokemon don't crack easily.

chapters.title: Stolen Goods
chapters.say: A grunt just ran off with something precious from the Devon Corporation. The tunnel east of Rustboro is a dead end... for now.

chapters.title: A Letter for Steven
chapters.say: Mr. Stone's son is exploring a cave on a far-off island. An old sailor and his boat can take you there.

chapters.title: Riding the Big Wave
chapters.say: Dewford's Gym Leader is a surfer, and his Gym is dark. His Fighting Pokemon hit like a crashing wave.

chapters.title: Chaos at the Museum
chapters.say: Slateport's Oceanic Museum is full of visitors today, and some of them aren't there to look at the exhibits.

chapters.title: Parts for the Captain
chapters.say: The Devon Parts are still in your Bag. Captain Stern's ship can't sail without them.

chapters.title: Rival on Route 110
chapters.say: {rival_name} has been training on Route 110. They want to see how far you've come.

chapters.title: Wally's Challenge
chapters.say: The shy boy from Petalburg is standing at the Mauville Gym's door. He isn't so shy any more.

chapters.title: The Laughing Leader
chapters.say: Mauville's Gym Leader laughs at everything. His Gym is a maze of crackling switches.

chapters.title: The Missing Professor
chapters.say: North through the ash, a professor's wife in Fallarbor is worried sick. Her husband hasn't come home.

chapters.title: Meteor Falls
chapters.say: The professor was taken to Meteor Falls, along with a stone that fell from the sky. Why would anyone want a meteorite?

chapters.title: Fire on the Mountain
chapters.say: The meteorite is on its way up Mt. Chimney. At the top, {leader} is waiting to use it.

chapters.title: The Hot Springs Gym
chapters.say: Lavaridge's Gym is full of steam and hot sand. Its new Leader is fiery... and trying very hard.

chapters.title: Father and Child
chapters.say: Four badges. Now there's only one Gym in Hoenn that really matters: your dad's.

chapters.title: A Stone That Shines
chapters.say: Wally's father has something for you back in Petalburg. Past it, Steven waits on Route 118, turning a strange stone over in his hand. It seems to shine from the inside.

chapters.title: The Weather Institute
chapters.say: Researchers on Route 119 study storms and sunshine. Today, someone has locked them inside.

chapters.title: Steven's Gift
chapters.say: Something invisible is blocking the way to Fortree's Gym. Steven might have a way to see it.

chapters.title: Wings Over Fortree
chapters.say: Fortree City is built in the treetops, and its Gym Leader flies higher than anyone.

chapters.title: The Mountain of Spirits
chapters.say: Mt. Pyre is where people remember their Pokemon. Today, {team} is climbing it, and they want what's kept at the top.

chapters.title: The Hideout by the Sea
chapters.say: {team} has a hideout near Lilycove, and a stolen submarine waiting inside.

chapters.title: Two Minds as One
chapters.say: Mossdeep's Gym is run by twins who think the same thoughts. Beating one of them means beating both.

chapters.title: The Space Center Siege
chapters.say: The Mossdeep Space Center has something {team} wants. They didn't knock.

chapters.title: Beneath the Sea
chapters.say: Deep under Hoenn's waters lies a cavern no one has seen. {leader} has found it.

chapters.title: The Ancient Awakening
chapters.say: {legend} has woken, and the sky over Sootopolis has gone wrong. Someone has to calm it before it's too late.

chapters.title: Rain over Sootopolis
chapters.say: The skies are clear again. Sootopolis's Gym Leader is back, and his Water Pokemon are as graceful as they are strong.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.say: Eight badges. The last road to the League is long and dark, and an old friend is waiting along it.

chapters.title: The Champion's Room
chapters.say: Four of Hoenn's strongest trainers, one after another. And at the very end, a familiar face.

chapters.title: A Stone from the Stars
chapters.say: Something huge is falling toward Hoenn. A mysterious woman named Zinnia seems to know more than she's saying.

chapters.title: The Sky Pillar
chapters.say: At the top of the Sky Pillar, the guardian of the skies is waiting to be called.

chapters.title: Into Space
chapters.say: There's only one way to stop the meteoroid: go up and meet it.

chapters.title: The Other Orb
chapters.say: Hoenn is safe, for now. But deep in the Cave of Origin, {other_legend} is stirring.

chapters.title: A Fateful Encounter
chapters.say: {rival_name} came by looking for you, then dashed home. Go and see him first. He can't sit still: there's a lake west of town, and a story about what lives in it.

chapters.title: The First Battle
chapters.say: The Starly are gone and a new partner stands beside you. Back home, {rival_name} is already itching to test theirs.

chapters.title: The Professor's Lab
chapters.say: The old man at the lake watched everything. In Sandgem Town, he has been expecting you.

chapters.title: The Big City
chapters.say: Route 202 runs north to Jubilife City, the biggest city in Sinnoh. The Professor's assistant is somewhere on the route, waiting to show you something.

chapters.title: Through Oreburgh Gate
chapters.say: East of Jubilife, the road climbs into a cave. {rival_name} has gone on ahead... and won't stop talking about the Gym.

chapters.title: Down the Mine
chapters.say: Oreburgh's Gym Leader isn't at his Gym. He's somewhere down in the coal mine, digging.

chapters.title: The Rock-Hard Leader
chapters.say: He's back from the mine with dust on his helmet. His Rock Pokemon don't crack easily.

chapters.title: Space Suits in Jubilife
chapters.say: Two people in strange suits have cornered the Professor in Jubilife. They talk about space... and energy.

chapters.title: The Flower Town
chapters.say: North through the Ravaged Path lies Floaroma Town, full of flowers and sweet honey. It looks peaceful. For now.

chapters.title: Wind Without Power
chapters.say: The windmills at the Valley Windworks have stopped turning. A little girl's father is trapped inside.

chapters.title: Into Eterna Forest
chapters.say: Eterna Forest is dark and easy to get lost in. Someone in there is hoping you'll walk with her.

chapters.title: The Grass Leader
chapters.say: Eterna's Gym is a garden, and its Leader hides among the trees. She loves Grass Pokemon more than anything.

chapters.title: The Galactic Building
chapters.say: A woman in black stands by the statue in Eterna. North of the city, a tall building gleams. Its doors are guarded.

chapters.title: Cycling Road
chapters.say: A bike, a long road downhill, and a tunnel through the mountain at the heart of Sinnoh.

chapters.title: The Leader Who Isn't Home
chapters.say: Hearthome's Gym Leader is busy with other things. The road east leads on, past ruins and fog.

chapters.title: Fists of Veilstone
chapters.say: Veilstone City is carved out of the rock. Its Gym Leader trains barefoot, and she isn't sure she's strong enough.

chapters.title: The Galactic Warehouse
chapters.say: Team Galactic's grunts are carrying boxes in and out of a warehouse in Veilstone. One of them looks very nervous.

chapters.title: South to the Marsh
chapters.say: Route 214 winds south past a quiet lake toward a marshy city by the sea.

chapters.title: The Mask of Pastoria
chapters.say: Pastoria's Gym Leader is a wrestler who loves the water. His Gym is full of moving pools.

chapters.title: The Old Charm
chapters.say: Cynthia's grandmother lives in Celestic Town, beyond the fog. The Charm in your Bag is very old. Someone else wants it.

chapters.title: The Elder's Gift
chapters.say: The Old Charm is home in Celestic's shrine. The town's Elder hasn't finished with you yet: she has something for a Trainer who can cross water.

chapters.title: Ghosts of Hearthome
chapters.say: Hearthome's Gym Leader is finally home. Her Gym is dark, and the lights only come on for the right answers.

chapters.title: Across the Water
chapters.say: West of Jubilife, past the sea, is a port city with a drawbridge and a library older than anyone can remember.

chapters.title: The Steel Father
chapters.say: Canalave's Gym Leader is Roark's father. He's louder, tougher, and his Steel Pokemon are harder still.

chapters.title: The Library Meeting
chapters.say: The Professor has found something in the Canalave Library: an old story about three Pokemon and three lakes.

chapters.title: Explosion at Lake Valor
chapters.say: A blast shook the ground. Lake Valor is empty, and Team Galactic is standing in the mud where the water used to be.

chapters.title: The Lake Back Home
chapters.say: Lake Verity, where it all started. {rival_name}'s mom lives just down the road. Commander Mars got there first.

chapters.title: Snowbound
chapters.say: The far north is buried in snow. The path to Snowpoint City is long, cold and very white.

chapters.title: The Ice Leader
chapters.say: Snowpoint's Gym is a sheet of ice. Its Leader is cheerful, stylish and completely fearless.

chapters.title: The Last Lake
chapters.say: Two lakes have fallen. Only Lake Acuity is left, and {rival_name} is already there.

chapters.title: Galactic Headquarters
chapters.say: All three lake Pokemon have been taken to Veilstone. Behind the doors of Team Galactic's HQ, a machine is humming.

chapters.title: The Summit
chapters.say: Cyrus has gone to the very top of Mt. Coronet. Up there, the ancient ruins are glowing. Time and space are about to tear.

chapters.title: The Shining City
chapters.say: Sinnoh is quiet again. To the east, Sunyshore City glitters in the sun, with a lighthouse at its tip.

chapters.title: The Bored Leader
chapters.say: Sunyshore's Gym Leader hasn't had a good battle in a long time. He's waiting to see if you're different.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.say: Eight badges. Past the waterfall, Victory Road twists through the dark, with the League at its end.

chapters.title: The Champion
chapters.say: {rival_name} wants one last battle. Then four of Sinnoh's strongest trainers. And at the very top, a familiar face.

chapters.title: The Girl in the Green Hat
chapters.say: Professor Juniper's assistant is somewhere in Aspertia with a Pokemon meant for you. {rival_name} has a hunch she's up at the Outlook.

chapters.title: Bianca's Tour
chapters.say: Your partner has fought its first battle. Bianca waves you toward the Pokemon Center, where someone else is waiting too.

chapters.title: A Catching Lesson
chapters.say: Bianca has gone on ahead through the north gate. On Route 19 she has something to show you, and the tall grass is rustling.

chapters.title: Alder's Town
chapters.say: A man with wild red hair passed you on the road east. Floccesy Town is quiet, but people there know his name.

chapters.title: Two Town Maps
chapters.say: {rival_name} ran off without his Town Map. Someone saw him training past Route 20, near the ranch on the hill.

chapters.title: The Missing Herdier
chapters.say: The ranch owners look worried. One of their Herdier hasn't come home, and the woods to the north are thick.

chapters.title: Alder's Training
chapters.say: Herdier is safe. Back in Floccesy, the old Champion is waiting with his students. He wants to see how you battle.

chapters.title: Lessons at the School
chapters.say: Aspertia's Gym sits behind the Trainers' School. Its Leader used to be a challenger himself, not long ago.

chapters.title: Up the Steps
chapters.say: A Hiker has stood guard on Route 20's steps for days. With a badge in your case, he might finally step aside.

chapters.title: The Loudest Gym in Unova
chapters.say: Virbank's Gym shakes with music every night. Its Leader plays bass, and her bandmates guard the stage.

chapters.title: A Star Is Born
chapters.say: A scout from Pokestar Studios has been watching you. North of Virbank, the cameras are ready to roll.

chapters.title: Trouble at the Docks
chapters.say: People in strange uniforms have been seen on Virbank's pier. {rival_name} is already there, and he's furious.

chapters.title: The Runaway Grunt
chapters.say: One of them slipped away west. Somewhere on Route 20, a grunt is hiding with a stolen Pokemon.

chapters.title: The Ship to Castelia
chapters.say: The Gym Leader's father has his boat tied up at the pier. Across the bay, the towers of Castelia wait.

chapters.title: The Big City
chapters.say: Castelia never stops moving. Somewhere up Gym Street, an artist runs a Gym full of cocoons.

chapters.title: Iris's Hunch
chapters.say: The Gym Leader is out. A girl with big hair has a feeling about Thumb Pier, and she won't wait for you.

chapters.title: Into the Sewers
chapters.say: {rival_name} chased a uniform down into the dark under the city. The tunnels go further than anyone thinks.

chapters.title: Through the Cocoons
chapters.say: Burgh is back in his Gym, hidden behind walls of sticky silk. Push through, and find the way to him.

UNOVA.title: The Man in the White Coat

chapters.title: Central Plaza
chapters.say: The fountain at the heart of Castelia draws a crowd. Today, a scientist in a white coat is watching it too.

chapters.title: Colress Waits
chapters.say: Past Castelia's north gate, the road to the desert is blocked. The man in the white coat has a theory to test, and he wants you.

chapters.title: The City of Lights
chapters.say: North of Join Avenue, Nimbasa City glows day and night. Somewhere past its gates, a famous model runs the Gym.

chapters.title: The Leader Is Out
chapters.say: The Gym's doors are open, but its Leader isn't home. Someone saw her heading for the roller coaster.

chapters.title: Elesa's Runway
chapters.say: The lights come up one by one along the catwalk. At the end of it, Elesa waits for her audience.

chapters.title: Trouble at Big Stadium
chapters.say: {rival_name}'s voice carries across the plaza. He's found Team Plasma, and he isn't going to let them walk away.

chapters.title: West to Route 5
chapters.say: Route 5 is crowded with performers, and someone at the drawbridge is making a scene. Driftveil lies beyond it.

chapters.title: Over the Drawbridge
chapters.say: The drawbridge is down at last. Across the river, Driftveil City waits, and so does whatever Team Plasma left behind.

chapters.title: Team Plasma, Old and New
chapters.say: On the hill north of the Gym stands a house full of people who used to wear Team Plasma's uniform. They say they've changed. {rival_name} isn't so sure.

chapters.title: Down the Mine
chapters.say: Clay's Gym is a mine, and the mine is dark. The conveyor belts rumble from platform to platform, and only the ones you've stood on light up.

chapters.title: The World Tournament
chapters.say: South of the city, Trainers from every region gather to find out who's strongest. Clay has saved you a place.

chapters.title: Aboard the Plasma Frigate
chapters.say: Grunts in black are running for the pier, where a ship with no flag waits. {rival_name} is already gone after them. Whoever is on that deck has been expecting company.

chapters.title: The Cold Snap
chapters.say: Somewhere near Lacunosa Town the air froze solid for a moment, colder than any winter. It happened at Castelia too, and Driftveil. Cheren is waiting at the Season Research Lab, and he doesn't like what the numbers say.

chapters.title: The Charged Stones
chapters.say: Stones hang in the air in Chargestone Cave, humming with power. Someone's voice echoes across the bridge and is gone. Mistralton's runway is on the far side.

chapters.title: The Wind Tunnel
chapters.say: Skyla's Gym is a hangar full of roaring turbines. When the wind kicks up, anyone out in the open goes flying back to the door. Time your run, and hide behind the walls.

chapters.title: Over the Mountain
chapters.say: Twist Mountain has caved in, and the road to Opelucid is gone. Skyla's plane is fuelled and waiting. All that's missing is a professor lost somewhere in Celestial Tower.

chapters.title: The Smouldering Mountain
chapters.say: Professor Juniper has a question that only Opelucid's Gym Leader can answer, and the only road east runs through Reversal Mountain. The rock there is warm to the touch. Bianca has already gone in, chasing a rumour.

chapters.title: The Town with Walls
chapters.say: North from Undella, then west along the cliffs. Lacunosa is ringed by a high wall, and the people there lock their doors before dark.

chapters.title: A Story for Nightfall
chapters.say: The professor has gone on ahead. An old woman in town remembers why the walls were built, if anyone will listen.

chapters.title: Ambush at the West Gate
chapters.say: Something is waiting by the west gate, and it isn't the creature from the story. {rival_name} has seen it too.

chapters.title: West to Opelucid
chapters.say: The road to Opelucid runs west over Route 12 and across a long wooden bridge. Its Gym Leader has the answers the professor is after.

chapters.title: The Dragon Mayor
chapters.say: Opelucid City's Gym Leader is also its mayor, and he keeps dragons. Somewhere in the Gym, a stone dragon's head goes up and down.

chapters.title: An Old Man's Story
chapters.say: Drayden is waiting outside the Gym. He knows something about the dragons the professor asked after, and he would rather say it indoors.

chapters.title: Ice over Opelucid
chapters.say: In a single moment, the whole city froze. Grunts in grey are walking the icy streets as if they own them.

chapters.title: The Splicers
chapters.say: Drayden has kept something hidden for two years, and Team Plasma has come to take it.

chapters.title: A Shadow at the Gate
chapters.say: The thieves are gone, but one of them is still watching from the east gate.

chapters.title: The Coldest Place
chapters.say: Cheren is on the line. Something in the far east of Unova is colder than any winter, and the only way there runs under the sea from Undella.

chapters.title: The Lily Pad Gym
chapters.say: Humilau City stands on stilts over the sea, and its Gym Leader would rather be surfing. The way to him is a maze of floating lily pads.

chapters.title: A Presence on Route 22
chapters.say: Something large moved through the trees on Route 22. A man in a lab coat is following it with a very strange machine.

chapters.title: The Sturdy Boulder
chapters.say: Seaside Cave is the only way through to the coast, and something with a very hard shell is sitting in the exit.

chapters.title: The Ship off Route 21
chapters.say: Out past Route 21, the ship with no flag waits again. This time it isn't sailing off without a fight.

chapters.title: Aboard the Frigate
chapters.say: The gangplank is down. Somewhere below deck, a door only opens for the right password, and the crew aren't sharing it.

chapters.title: Thrown Overboard
chapters.say: The Command Center held something enormous and frozen. Then the shadows moved, and the ship was gone.

chapters.title: Into the Giant Chasm
chapters.say: Cheren says the frigate was heading for the Giant Chasm, a crater in the forest past Route 22 where a meteor fell long ago. The cold seems to start there.

chapters.title: The Frigate in the Forest
chapters.say: The ship has come to rest among the trees, gangway down. Somewhere aboard, the man who started all this is waiting.

chapters.title: The Deepest Room
chapters.say: Past the forest, a cave runs down into the crater's heart. The air there is so cold it hurts to breathe.

chapters.title: The Last Road
chapters.say: The ice over Opelucid has melted. N says the League is waiting, and the only road there runs north past Route 23.

chapters.title: The League at Last
chapters.say: Past the last cave, the Pokemon League stands at the top of the mountain. Four of Unova's strongest wait inside, one in each tower, in any order you like.

chapters.title: Down to the Champion
chapters.say: All four towers are quiet now. Back in the plaza, the statue's plaque points the way down, to the Champion waiting below.

chapters.title: Dust and Diesel
chapters.say: The Outskirt Stand sits alone in the desert, an old train turned diner. A young rider at the far end has been watching the door since you came in.

chapters.title: The Sack on the Road
chapters.say: Two men in odd clothes passed this way with a sack that moved. They were heading for Phenac City, and so are you.

chapters.title: Eyes That See Shadows
chapters.say: The girl from the sack sees something in certain Pokemon that nobody else can: a dark glow, like smoke. Phenac's mayor ought to hear about it.

chapters.title: A Jacket You Know
chapters.say: Someone in Phenac is wearing a Team Snagem jacket. Not long ago, you wore one just like it.

chapters.title: An Empty Belt
chapters.say: A Snag Machine on your arm, and not one Poke Ball to throw. The bartender back at the Outskirt Stand keeps a box under the counter.

chapters.title: Trouble at the Mayor's
chapters.say: Shouting, from the direction of the mayor's house. Something's wrong.

chapters.title: Three at the Gates
chapters.say: Strangers in matching outfits stand at every road out of Phenac, and each one keeps a Pokemon with that same dark glow.

chapters.title: The Stadium by the Fountain
chapters.say: Phenac Stadium has opened its doors to challengers. Four rounds, and at the end of them, a Gym Leader who fights like the tide.

chapters.title: A Town Without Law
chapters.say: Pyrite Town: no sheriff worth the name, and dark Pokemon passed hand to hand in the duel square. Someone called Cail knows where they come from.

chapters.title: Duking's Windmill
chapters.say: Duking's house stands under the great windmill at the edge of Pyrite. Something about the sails looks wrong today.

chapters.title: The Stolen Gear
chapters.say: The windmill has stopped and the Colosseum has gone dark. A missing gear, a thief called Silva, and a building site out past the bridge.

chapters.title: The Gear for Duking
chapters.say: The Gear is heavy in your bag, and Pyrite's Colosseum is still dark. Duking has been pacing his front room all day.

chapters.title: Lights On at the Colosseum
chapters.say: The windmill turns again. Pyrite's Colosseum is lit, and its Leader is waiting at the end of four rounds.

chapters.title: The Building by the Bridge
chapters.say: Duking's Plusle has been taken. The trail leads up through the Pyrite Building, past guards who don't want visitors, to its roof.

chapters.title: Music in the Cave
chapters.say: Somewhere in Pyrite Cave, someone is playing very loud music. Follow the beat.

chapters.title: The Village in the Trees
chapters.say: Agate Village is green, quiet, and old. Rui's grandparents live there, and a fortune-teller saw trouble heading their way.

chapters.title: Into the Relic Cave
chapters.say: Footprints lead into the Relic Cave, and an old man went in after them alone.

chapters.title: The Number Gardens
chapters.say: Agate has a Gym, and two Leaders who battle side by side. Its gardens are a puzzle of numbers before they are a battle.

chapters.title: Smoke on Mt. Battle
chapters.say: Something is wrong on the mountain next to Agate. Trainers are coming down beaten and shaking.

chapters.title: A Gift from the Top
chapters.say: Mt. Battle is quiet again. The trainer at the top of its first area has been waiting to say something, and whoever ran off in such a hurry dropped something shiny on the way.

chapters.title: The Jail Key
chapters.say: Two of Miror B.'s men sit in Pyrite's cells. Whatever they're carrying, they aren't going to hand it over.

chapters.title: Down the Giant Lift
chapters.say: Beneath the Pyrite Building, a lift big enough for a truck goes down and down. At the bottom is a whole town that never sees the sun.

chapters.title: A Spy in a Cage
chapters.say: Somebody in The Under has been locked away for asking too many questions.

chapters.title: On Air
chapters.say: Every screen in The Under shows the same smiling face. Her studio floats above the town, if you can find the way up.

chapters.title: The Old Subway
chapters.say: She ran for the back stairs, down into tunnels nobody has used in years.

chapters.title: The Under Colosseum
chapters.say: The Under has its own Colosseum, and the winner walks away with more than a trophy.

chapters.title: The Lab in the Sand
chapters.say: Out in the desert stands a building with no sign and a locked gate. This is where the dark Pokemon are made.

chapters.title: A Disk Full of Secrets
chapters.say: A Data ROM, dropped in a hurry. The kids in The Under are good at opening things that are meant to stay shut.

chapters.title: Cold Halls in the Ruins
chapters.say: The old Snagem hideout is a Gym now. The halls have gone cold, and the Leader inside likes it that way.

chapters.title: Four Coloured Keys
chapters.say: Realgam Tower glitters like a jewel in the sand. Behind it, four old enemies each hold a key to one great door.

chapters.title: The Tower Halls
chapters.say: The great door is open. Beyond it, long halls and the lifts at their far end.

chapters.title: No Rest at the Top
chapters.say: The roof Colosseum. Match after match, and no Pokemon Center between them. Whoever runs Cipher is watching from the best seat.

chapters.title: An Empty Lab
chapters.say: Five years have passed. Professor Krane's lab near Gateon Port studies how to heal dark hearts. Today the door is open and nobody answers.

chapters.title: A Machine Part
chapters.say: The Purify Chamber needs a part nobody in Gateon has. The shopkeeper at the Parts Shop might know someone who does.

chapters.title: Down at Kaminko's
chapters.say: Perr's father went to visit a very strange inventor and never came back. Kaminko's house is full of machines, and one small, loud assistant guards the stairs.

chapters.title: The Lighthouse
chapters.say: Gateon's bridges swing back into place, and the lighthouse on the islands is lit. Three guardians stand between you and the top.

chapters.title: A Part at Last
chapters.say: Makan made it home to the Parts Shop. He has been rummaging through his shelves for something with exactly the right shape.

chapters.title: Back to Lily
chapters.say: The part is in your bag. Lily has been waiting at the lab with the Purify Chamber open.

chapters.title: The Lab Reopened
chapters.say: A car with no plates was seen driving toward the old lab in the sand. The professor might still be inside.

chapters.title: Data for Nett
chapters.say: Professor Krane is safe, and his research needs a pair of clever eyes at the ONBS building.

chapters.title: Static on the Airwaves
chapters.say: Orre's TV station has stopped broadcasting the news. Someone else is holding the microphone now.

chapters.title: Strangers Wearing Phenac
chapters.say: Phenac looks the same, but the faces are wrong. Even the mayor's people aren't who they say they are.

chapters.title: Locked Below
chapters.say: There are voices under the Pre Gym, and a key in your hand.

chapters.title: A Runaway
chapters.say: Someone who got away from Cipher is hiding at the Outskirt Stand, jumping at every noise.

chapters.title: The Desert Gang
chapters.say: Team Snagem has crept back into its old desert hideout. Its boss never did like losing.

chapters.title: The Biggest Stage in Orre
chapters.say: The Orre Colosseum: the biggest crowd, the biggest prize, and a final against a face you know.

chapters.title: A Door in Gateon Port
chapters.say: There's a building in Gateon Port with a thug at the door and no name on the wall.

chapters.title: Lights in the Maze
chapters.say: Corridors that loop back on themselves, crates to shift, and a lever sitting on a table as if someone forgot it.

chapters.title: Gorigan's Hall
chapters.say: The power is back on. At the top of the Lair, a very large man is waiting with his fists ready.

chapters.title: Norman's Hall
chapters.say: Gorigan's hall has a new master, and he has been training for exactly this fight.

chapters.title: A Gift Before the Storm
chapters.say: Cipher's Grand Master waits on an island far out to sea. Professor Krane has something for you before you go.

chapters.title: Citadark Isle
chapters.say: Citadark Isle: a fortress, a volcano, and a tower with a dome on top. Something enormous is shut away up there.

chapters.title: An Ancient Force
chapters.say: At the top of the Dome, a Gym Leader with dragons stands between you and the Grand Master's arena.

chapters.title: The Shadow at the Summit
chapters.say: The arena is open. The Grand Master is small, and smiling, and has been waiting a long time.

chapters.title: The Colosseum in the Sky
chapters.say: Cipher is gone. High above Realgam Tower, a Colosseum in the sky has a Gym Leader of its own.

chapters.title: Five Battles in the Sky
chapters.say: Eight badges. The Orre League waits at Realgam: four of Orre's strongest, one after another, and then its Champion.
